title: Gwen
creator: CrossFit
description: Clean and jerks for 15, 12 and 9 unbroken reps, touch-and-go at the floor, using the same load for all three sets and resting as needed between them. Scored by load, not time: the score is the heaviest weight you complete all three sets with. Regripping or dumping the bar ends the set.
